1: // Gravity Flip Runner – minimal canvas game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
8: 
9:   // player
10:   const player = {x: 50, size: 20, y: H - 20, vy: 0, gravity: 0.6, onGround: true, dir: -1}; // dir -1 = floor, 1 = ceiling
11: 
12:   // obstacles (spikes)
13:   const spikes = [];
14:   let spawnTimer = 0;
15:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1200; // ms
16:   let lastTime = 0;
17:   let running = true;
18: 
19:   // flip gravity on tap/click
20:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
21:     player.dir *= -1; // swap floor/ceiling
22:     player.vy = 0;
23:     player.onGround = false;
24:   });
25: 
26:   function spawnSpike() {
27:     const size = 20;
28:     const y = player.dir === -1 ? H - size : 0; // attach to floor/ceiling
29:     spikes.push({x: W, y, size});
30:   }
31: 
32:   function update(dt) {
33:     // player vertical motion
34:     if (!player.onGround) {
35:       player.vy += player.gravity * player.dir * dt / 16;
36:       player.y += player.vy;
37:     }
38:     // clamp to floor/ceiling
39:     if (player.dir === -1 && player.y >= H - player.size) {
40:       player.y = H - player.size; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true;
41:     } else if (player.dir === 1 && player.y <= 0) {
42:       player.y = 0; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true;
43:     }
44: 
45:     // move spikes
46:     for (let i = spikes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
47:       spikes[i].x -= 2; // constant speed
48:       // collision detection (simple AABB)
49:       if (
50:         player.x < spikes[i].x + spikes[i].size &&
51:         player.x + player.size > spikes[i].x &&
52:         player.y < spikes[i].y + spikes[i].size &&
53:         player.y + player.size > spikes[i].y
54:       ) {
55:         running = false; // lose
56:       }
57:       // remove off‑screen
58:       if (spikes[i].x + spikes[i].size < 0) spikes.splice(i, 1);
59:     }
60: 
61:     // spawn logic
62:     spawnTimer += dt;
63:     if (spawnTimer > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
64:       spawnSpike();
65:       spawnTimer = 0;
66:     }
67:   }
68: 
69:   function draw() {
70:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
71:     // player
72:     ctx.fillStyle = '#09f';
73:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size);
74:     // spikes
75:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
76:     spikes.forEach(s => {
77:       ctx.beginPath();
78:       if (player.dir === -1) {
79:         // floor spike – triangle pointing up
80:         ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + s.size);
81:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size / 2, s.y);
82:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size, s.y + s.size);
83:       } else {
84:         // ceiling spike – triangle pointing down
85:         ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y);
86:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size / 2, s.y + s.size);
87:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size, s.y);
88:       }
89:       ctx.closePath();
90:       ctx.fill();
91:     });
92:     // game over overlay
93:     if (!running) {
94:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
95:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
96:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
97:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
98:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
99:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
100:     }
101:   }
102: 
103:   function loop(timestamp) {
104:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
105:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
106:     lastTime = timestamp;
107:     if (running) update(dt);
108:     draw();
109:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
110:   }
111:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
112: })();
